mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tours (title, description, destination, catalogueId, price, createdBy) VALUES (#{title}, #{description}, #{destination}, #{catalogueId}, #{price}, #{createdBy})
mapper.update:
UPDATE tours
title = #{title},
description = #{description},
destination = #{destination},
catalogueId = #{catalogueId},
price = #{price},
WHERE tourId = #{tourId}
mapper.select: SELECT t.tourId, t.catalogueId, t.title, t.destination, t.description, t.price, t.createdBy FROM tours t WHERE t.tourId = #{tourId}
SELECT t.tourId, t.catalogueId, t.title, t.destination, t.description, t.price, t.createdBy FROM tours t WHERE t.catalogueId = #{catalogueId} ORDER BY t.updateTime
